headline: Honors Pilot for Career Technical Education at Medford High School, plus opening of schools and Superintendent's goals for SY26-27.
summary: The agenda includes executive sessions on a grievance with the Medford Teachers Association and on potential litigation. Public session items include a $10,000.00 donation from Watts Water Technologies and several Superintendent reports.
items: Executive session on collective bargaining regarding a grievance dated 5.13.2026 with the Medford Teachers Association (MTA)
Executive session to discuss strategy for potential litigation (Zia Shaikh ppa v. City of Medford)
Approval of donation from Watts Water Technologies, $10,000.00
Honors Pilot for Career Technical Education (CTE) at Medford High School, presented by Dr. Kim Talbot and Chad Fallon
Opening of Schools, presented by Dr. Suzanne B Galusi
Superintendent's Goals for SY26-27, presented by Dr. Suzanne B Galusi
Presentations of the Student Advisory Council
Presentations of the Public (not to begin before 7:00 pm)
Condolences to the family of Lorraine Miles
Condolences to the family of Gerald H. Wadness
location: Howard Alden Memorial Chambers, Medford City Hall, and via Zoom
